passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: We are a leading developer and operator of high-performance data centers in China. In addition, we hold a minority equity interest in DayOne, a Singapore-headquartered data center platform. We accounted for the international business and operations outside mainland China conducted by DayOne as discontinued operations as a result of our loss of control over DayOne on December 31, 2024 following the closing of DayOne’s Series B equity financing. Unless otherwise stated, the discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations in this section apply to our financial information as prepared in accordance with U.S. GAAP. You should read the following discussion and analysis of our financial position and results of operations in conjunction with our consolidated financial statements and the related notes included elsewhere in this annual report. In addition, our consolidated financial statements and the financial data included in this annual report reflect our recent discontinued operations discussed above, and retrospective adjustments have been made throughout the relevant periods to provide a consistent basis of comparison for the financial results. In addition, to assist in evaluating the discontinued operations disclosure, we have included certain operation and financial measures of discontinued operations and have divided the analysis into separate discussions for continuing operations and discontinued operations. Furthermore, our discussion contains forward-looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties. Our actual results and the timing of selected events could differ materially from those anticipated in these forward-looking statements as a result of various factors, including those set forth under “Item 3. Key Information—D. Risk Factors” and elsewhere in this annual report. Overview We are a leading developer and operator of high-performance data centers in China. Our facilities are strategically located in primary economic hubs where demand for high-performance data center services is concentrated. Our data centers are designed and configured as high-performance data centers with large net floor area and power capacity, high power density and efficiency, and multiple redundancy across all critical systems. We are carrier and cloud neutral, which enables our customers to access all the major telecommunications networks, as well as the largest PRC and global public clouds which we host in many of our facilities. We offer colocation and managed services, including an innovative and unique managed cloud value proposition. We have a 25-year track record of service delivery, successfully fulfilling the requirements of some of the largest and most demanding customers for outsourced data center services. As of December 31, 2025, we had an aggregate net floor area of 668,283 sqm in service, 93% of which was committed by customers, and an aggregate net floor area of 73,994 sqm under construction, 66.1% of which was pre-committed by customers. passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: Summary of Risk Factors An investment in our ADSs and/or ordinary shares involves significant risks. Below is a summary of material risks we face, organized under relevant headings. These risks are discussed more fully in “Item 3. Key Information—D. Risk Factors.” Risks Relating to Our Business and Industry ● A slowdown in the demand for data center capacity or managed services could have a material adverse effect on us; ● Our business is increasingly exposed to risks arising from the rapid development and adoption of artificial intelligence technologies, including uncertainties in infrastructure demands, investment returns and regulatory environment, all of which could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations; ● Any inability to manage the growth of our operations could disrupt our business and reduce our profitability; ● Our business requires us to make significant capital expenditures and resource commitments prior to recognizing revenue for those services; ● The data center business is capital-intensive, and we expect our capacity to generate capital in the short term will be insufficient to meet our anticipated capital requirements; ● Our substantial level of indebtedness could adversely affect our ability to raise additional capital to fund our operations, expose us to interest rate risk to the extent of our variable rate debt and prevent us from meeting our obligations under our indebtedness. 13 Table of Contents ● Our net revenue is highly dependent on a limited number of customers, and the loss of, or any significant decrease in business from, any one or more of our major customers or from any major contract with any customer could adversely affect our financial condition and results of operations; credit_strengths.text: GDS is a leading developer and operator of high-performance data centers in China, with a long operating track record and facilities concentrated in primary economic hubs. Its in-service capacity is substantially committed by customers, and a meaningful portion of capacity under construction is already pre-committed, which supports revenue visibility and cash-flow generation.

Operating cash flow strengthened materially in the latest fiscal year, covering cash capital expenditure and contributing to a solid cash balance. This internal cash generation, together with a current ratio comfortably above the sector median, provides a liquidity cushion against near-term maturities and supports the issuer's ability to fund committed expansion.

key_risks.text: The data center business is capital-intensive, and the issuer discloses that its capacity to generate capital in the short term will be insufficient to meet anticipated capital requirements. Significant capital expenditures and resource commitments are made before revenue is recognized, so funding needs may outpace internal cash generation and require continued external financing.

Borrowings are heavily weighted to long-term debt, with a large portion maturing after year five, but the debt note shows a substantial current portion of long-term borrowings due within the next twelve months. Refinancing this amount depends on continued access to onshore and offshore credit markets, and short-term borrowing costs have been volatile.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Gross leverage is elevated and sits well above the sector median, while net leverage is also above the sector median on a comparable basis. Operating income was marginally negative, so interest coverage is effectively nil and cash flow coverage of debt is weak, indicating that debt service currently relies on EBITDA and refinancing rather than operating profit.

Free cash flow was negative as capital expenditure exceeded operating cash flow, so the issuer does not generate internal cash to repay debt. With no disclosed dividends or buybacks, cash uses are dominated by growth capex. The maturity profile is manageable near term, but refinancing risk remains material given the size of borrowings relative to cash flow.

overall_credit_view.text: The indicative financial risk profile is Significant, driven by leverage above the sector median and cash-flow coverage below the sector median. The issuer has meaningful headroom to the next leverage threshold, but an EBITDA decline or additional debt could push it into a weaker tier. The Altman Z double prime zone is Grey, consistent with a capital-intensive, leveraged profile.

Our forward view is that credit quality depends on stabilizing operating income, converting committed capacity into revenue, and maintaining access to refinancing. The disclosed risks around customer concentration, pricing pressure, and AI-driven demand uncertainty could pressure cash flow. We would monitor leverage, interest coverage, and refinancing progress as key rating drivers.

credit_strengths.text: GDS是中國領先的高性能數據中心開發商及營運商，擁有悠久的營運往績，設施集中於主要經濟樞紐。其已投入服務的產能獲客戶大量承諾，而在建產能中有相當部分已獲預先承諾，這支持收入可見度及現金流產生。
營運現金流於最近一個財政年度大幅增強，足以覆蓋現金資本開支並貢獻穩健的現金結餘。此內部現金產生能力，加上流動比率舒適地高於行業中位數，為短期到期債務提供流動性緩衝，並支持發行人為已承諾擴張提供資金的能力。

key_risks.text: 數據中心業務屬資本密集型，發行人披露其短期內產生資本的能力將不足以滿足預期資本需求。重大資本開支及資源承諾於收入確認前作出，因此資金需求可能超出內部現金產生能力，並需要持續的外部融資。
借款嚴重偏向長期債務，其中大部分於五年後到期，但債務附註顯示長期借款中有相當部分為將於未來十二個月內到期的流動部分。為該金額再融資取決於能否持續進入在岸及離岸信貸市場，而短期借款成本一直波動。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 總槓桿偏高，遠高於行業中位數，而淨槓桿按可比基準亦高於行業中位數。營運收入輕微為負，因此利息覆蓋實際上為零，現金流對債務的覆蓋疲弱，表明目前債務償付依賴EBITDA及再融資，而非營運利潤。
自由現金流為負，因資本開支超過營運現金流，故發行人並無產生內部現金以償還債務。在並無披露股息或回購的情況下，現金用途以增長型資本開支為主。短期內到期結構可控，但鑑於借款相對現金流的規模，再融資風險仍然重大。

overall_credit_view.text: 指示性財務風險狀況為顯著，受槓桿高於行業中位數及現金流覆蓋低於行業中位數所驅動。發行人距離下一個槓桿門檻有顯著緩衝空間，但EBITDA下降或額外債務可能將其推入較弱級別。Altman Z雙素區域為灰色，與資本密集型、高槓桿的狀況一致。
我們的前瞻觀點是，信貸質素取決於營運收入穩定、將已承諾產能轉化為收入，以及維持再融資渠道。已披露有關客戶集中度、定價壓力及AI驅動需求不確定性的風險可能對現金流構成壓力。我們將監察槓桿、利息覆蓋及再融資進展作為關鍵評級驅動因素。
